summary: The Toronto-Dominion Bank filed a Form 6-K with a press release dated August 11, 2026, announcing the full redemption of its US$1.5 billion 3.625% Non-Viability Contingent Capital Subordinated Notes due 2031. The redemption will occur on September 15, 2026, at par plus accrued interest. This is a routine debt redemption, not a special-situation event, as it involves no equity, change of control, or strategic shift.
